Business purchasing, simplified. Apply for a dedicated line of credit today.
Get instant credit line approval1 and 30-day net terms.
Integrate with your Accounts Payable and connect POs.
A hassle-free experience that supports company-wide purchasing.
Sign Up for a Business Account
If you haven’t already, register for a WD business account.
Review our application checklist prior to starting your application.
Get instant approval1 and start shopping within minutes.
Pay invoices in 30 days. Plus, easily manage authorized buyers online.
Use your credit line for more purchases and track all activity in one place.
There are no annual membership fees for your WD Credit account. Your business will not incur any interest or late fees if your invoices are paid by the invoice due date.
No, applying for WD Credit will not affect your personal credit score.

Credit limit increase requests require that your account be in good standing for a minimum of six months, demonstrating positive payment history on your account. Credit limit increase requests may be submitted by visiting the overview landing page at westerndigitalcredit.com. You will receive notification by email of the outcome of your request. To login to your account at any time, please visit westerndigitalcredit.com/login.
Yes, the westerndigitalcredit.com website, operated by TreviPay, lets you add new users with assigned purchasing and payment roles.
Your current available balance, outstanding amount due, and past invoices will be available on the Account Overview page at westerndigitalcredit.com.

You will receive a downloadable invoice at westerndigitalcredit.com and by email immediately after your products are shipped. The invoice will contain the payment due date. To direct these alerts to your accounts payable department, create a new Payer user account for your accounts payable team and activate invoice alerts in the Notifications tab of the Edit User page.

You or your designated account user can make payments to our partner, TreviPay, through one of the following payment methods: direct debit in your buyer portal, by automated clearing house (ACH) payment, or by check. For convenience, you may link your business bank account to make payments easily. All available payment methods will also be outlined on each invoice you receive.

If you currently have more than one invoice open with WD, TreviPay will apply payments based on the remittance advice you provide. If no remittance advice is submitted, we will apply payments to the oldest invoices first so that you are not considered late on older invoices.
Please contact WD Customer Service at (877-278-2165) or email us at support@westerndigitalcredit.com to speak with an expert. Our hours of operation are M-F 8:00 am-5:00 pm CST.
Your WD Credit account is made available for business purchases on WesternDigital.com only.
A complete history of your account activity is available on your Account Overview page at westerndigitalcredit.com.

TreviPay (www.trevipay.com) is a global B2B payments company, facilitating $6 billion in transactions per year in 18 currencies for customers in more than 27 countries. TreviPay specializes in payment and credit management for B2B companies across the globe, setting the stage for the future of omni-channel B2B payments by extending terms, handling invoicing, and managing collections. TreviPay is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas and has offices across the globe, including Australia, the Netherlands, and Mexico.

Disclosures 1. Up to $250,000, if all application requirements are met. Legal entity in business 2+years; not a sole proprietor. TreviPay receives a completed and executed Account Application. TreviPay may require additional financial documentation, such as two (2) years audited financials to complete application. Twelve (12) months of positive financial history with no negative change to entity profile. Applicant is not, at the time of review, in Bankruptcy or there is no public indication of an impending insolvency.
Online Store Support: US +1 (855)-799-5529 Monday — Friday, 8am — 5pm PST

Credit Application Checklist Before you start your application for Western Digital Credit, gather the following information: DBA/Trade Name Physical Address Billing Address (if different from physical address) Accounts Payable Contact Information Business Type (corporation, federal, LLC, partnership, sole proprietor, etc.) Industry (education, health services, legal, retail, etc.) Company Tax ID Number Year Established Number of Employees Requested Credit Line Amount Bank Account Number and Routing Number (only needed if you choose to pay invoices via ACH direct debit)
